scope: Silent Metal geometry-query microbenchmark. Existing segment/BVH kernels, direct analytic boxes, analytic SDF, and conservative 512x512 grid SDF with analytic fallback within one 0.25m cell. CPU submission+GPU completion/readback divided by 8 dispatches; not isolated GPU timestamps or full audio transport. Seven rotated-order timings after warmup. Unresolved SDF marches are not misses. WriteOnly is timing overhead control, not geometry. Grid bake measured separately once per case including dispatch/synchronization; first use can include shader setup.
supersedes: run02 miss-step instrumentation; do not pool timings
